scope.adaptive_selection_bias: Extra samples selected after initial noisy outcomes. Conditional intervals are descriptive, not confirmatory or multiplicity-corrected. Validation diagnostics were inspected and are now development data.
scope.public_scenarios: No reconstructed unknown-hand belief benchmark; all rollouts condition on source private hands, which are never inputs to policies. No general hidden-hand win guarantee.
scope.first_important_error: No earliest causal error certified. Unsupported is a coverage label, not an error label.
scope.effect_of_tool_evolution: V1 had 160 roots/180 maximum; v2 had 180/180, using new C1 trajectories and distinct nonforced roots. Original unsupported actions retained 5/60 then 20/60. The C2 root-local rejection fix is exercised by the Bot2 Juggler/Hounds diagnostic and actual subsequent games.
